claim: NullPropagatedOperands recurses into both operands of every SqlBinaryExpression without checking OperatorType, but AndAlso/OrElse do not propagate NULL from both operands under three-valued logic (NULL AND FALSE = FALSE, NULL OR TRUE = TRUE). The IS NOT NULL guard is dropped where it is load-bearing, so the CASE returns false/true where it previously returned NULL, changing projected values and WHERE row sets; EF's own null-semantics compensation injects OR x IS NULL so no user-written boolean operator is required to hit it.
raw: #1 🔴 Critical: `NullPropagatedOperands` treats every `SqlBinaryExpression` as propagating NULL from both operands, but `AndAlso`/`OrElse` do not — queries silently return wrong values and wrong rows

claim: All five new tests use only unconditionally NULL-propagating operators (bitwise ~, integer +, string concatenation); none uses a boolean result, an &&/|| result, a comparison result, or a WHERE-clause position. The optimization's entire risk surface is untested, which is why the critical defect passed the suite.
raw: #2 🟡 Medium: No test covers a boolean-typed WHEN result, which is exactly where the optimization's premise breaks

claim: NullPropagatedOperands walks the whole result subtree and inserts every node into a HashSet<SqlExpression> before DropNotNullChecks establishes that the test contains any IS NOT NULL to drop. SqlExpression hashing is structural and uncached, so this costs O(N x depth) node visits for every eligible CASE, including the majority that can never yield a drop.
raw: #3 🟢 Low: The operand set is built for every eligible CASE, including those whose test contains no `IS NOT NULL` check at all

claim: RestoreNullValueColumnsList(currentNonNullableColumnsCount) passes the non-nullable-columns watermark to the null-value columns restore, while the sibling call at line 529 correctly uses currentNullValueColumnsCount. The wrong watermark either over-truncates or under-truncates _nullValueColumns after each WHEN clause. Pre-existing, untouched by this change.
raw: P1 🟡 Medium: `RestoreNullValueColumnsList` given the non-nullable-columns watermark

claim: The guard requires IsNull(elseResult), but a CaseExpression with no ELSE at all (elseResult is null) is semantically identical to ELSE NULL and IsNull(null) returns false, so the optimization silently does not apply to that equivalent shape. Consider (elseResult is null || IsNull(elseResult)).
raw: Consistency — `src/EFCore.Relational/Query/SqlNullabilityProcessor.cs:578` — the guard requires `IsNull(elseResult)`, but a `CaseExpression` with no ELSE at all (`elseResult is null`) is semantically identical to `ELSE NULL`
